question: I went to Virtue restaurant & bar in Chicago for my birthday on March 22, 2021 and the main course I had was delicious!  Unfortunately, when I went back about a month later on April 21, it was no longer on the dinner menu.  Using the Wayback Machine, can you help me figure out which main course was on the dinner menu for Virtue on March 22, 2021 but not April 21, 2021? Answer using the singular form, without articles.

This was an inappropriate tool choice for a task that explicitly required accessing archived web pages via the Wayback Machine. FileSurfer cannot retrieve online archives, causing wasted effort and derailing the optimal workflow (FM-4.3 Tool Selection Error). The mis-selection contributed to reliance on partially rendered April snapshots and incomplete verification, leading to the incorrect conclusion ('catfish') instead of the true missing item ('shrimp').
